summary: Tested FortexaRH dashboard fixes: Top 10 Salaries showing actual values (not RD$0), drill-down showing proper ranks (not NaN), notification endpoints working with new /notification-settings prefix. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI verification confirms fixes are working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard fixes verified. Key fixes: 1) Top 10 Salaries in PayrollDashboard now uses salary field instead of base_salary (server.py line 2230-2236), showing actual values like RD$120,000 instead of RD$0. 2) Drill-down modal ranks display 1,2,3,4,5,6 correctly (no NaN). 3) NotificationsPage uses /api/notification-settings/* endpoints successfully. 4) Notification bell (GET /api/notifications, /api/notifications/count) from notifications_system.py works correctly. 5) Translation displays correctly in Spanish without raw keys.

rca_of_the_issue.top_10_salaries_bug: Backend was using base_salary field which doesn't exist on employee records. The salary field contains the actual value. Fixed by changing emp.get('base_salary', 0) to emp.get('salary', emp.get('base_salary', 0)) with fallback.
rca_of_the_issue.drilldown_nan_bug: Frontend handleDrillDown was accessing top_salaries before stats was destructured in scope. Fixed by using stats?.top_salaries || [] directly.
rca_of_the_issue.notification_prefix_conflict: Both notifications.py and notifications_system.py were using /notifications prefix causing route conflicts. Fixed by renaming notifications.py (settings/reminders) to use /notification-settings prefix.
